title: Audit wolfCrypt struct init: all paths must follow z3c7 memset pattern
description: C_Sign correctly memsets Hmac to zero before wc_HmacInit (wolfP11-z3c7 pattern) because wc_HmacFree inspects internal state to decide what to wipe; an uninitialised struct risks garbage-pointer dereference. Audit all wolfCrypt struct uses (Sha256, Sha512, RsaKey, ecc_key, etc.) across all operation paths to verify the memset-before-init pattern is consistently applied.
